purpose: Improve B4 V small-flame recall and T false detections using only existing data
frozen_baseline: E2 V/T, 960 input, original development thresholds V flame 0.37 and T hotspot 0.14
development_split: historically exposed B4 validation; used only for exploratory candidate selection
confirmation_split: no threshold or candidate selection; evaluate once only after a development gate passes

V_candidates.change: E2 V inference input 960 to 1280; same weights, NMS, labels
E2 V inference input 960 to 1536; same weights, NMS, labels
V_candidates.run_if: V1280 does not pass the development gate and GPU memory permits

V_development_gate.threshold_selection: 0.01 to 0.90 step 0.01, highest recall among P>=0.60; ties P then higher threshold

T_candidates.change: apply stricter class-aware NMS IoU 0.45 to saved E2 T predictions; keep threshold 0.14
keep NMS IoU 0.45 and scan work threshold on development only

deployment_gate.failure_action: keep frozen E2 default and report reasons

constraints: No extra training from development or confirmation images
No use of smoke for localization
